title: RenewalPeriod
description: Generic recurrence descriptor used by any benefit that resets on a schedule. Covers monthly credits, quarterly rotating categories, and multi-year perks (Global Entry every 4 years, free night award every membership year) with the same shape.

count.description: How many units make one cycle. Monthly = unit:month,count:1. Every 4 years = unit:year,count:4.

anchor.description: calendar = natural month/quarter/year boundaries. card_anniversary = counted from the cardholder's account-open date. membership_year = issuer-defined membership year (e.g. some Amex benefits). fixed_dates = irregular, issuer-announced dates (e.g. rotating 5% categories) — see fixedDates.

fixedDates.description: Only used when anchor = fixed_dates. List of actual effective start dates as announced by the issuer, since these don't always align with calendar quarters.
